data.one_liner: AppBar widget that changes its content based on the scrolling rate to implement large titles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable space bar widget for SliverAppBar that exposes a scrolling rate parameter. This allows developers to dynamically scale, position, and alter UI elements like text size and padding as the user scrolls.
use_when: You want to implement a 'Large Title' style collapsing app bar in Flutter.
You need custom animations or layout changes inside an AppBar driven by scroll position.
avoid_when: You are not using a CustomScrollView or SliverAppBar.
You only need a standard static AppBar.
strengths: Provides a direct scrollingRate variable for fine-grained layout control.
Integrates seamlessly with standard Flutter SliverAppBars.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic README example.
No advanced pre-built animations other than what you code via the builder.
